Name: UI Info Suite 2 Redux
Author: Ekysoh
Description:
Here's the start of my rework for UI info Suite 2. The aim is to have this compatible with mods that neither the UI Info Suite 2 Android and OG UI Info Suite 2 currently support. Original code is based off Cdaragorn's and Annosz's work. 
﻿Below are the new features so far:
[list]
[*]Mobile fully supported[/*]
[*]Rearrange HUD (Health/Energy/Experience bars, buff icons, day icons, notifications, toolbars)[/*]
[*]SpaceCore Skills[/*]
[*]Inspect mode (for CinderTap and TapToMove)[/*]
[*]Social Page tracking for gifts/conversations[/*]
[*]New icons for festivals, legendary fish, bookseller, traveling cart when it has items for bundle, wedding/anniversary dates [/*]
[*]Quest Tracker[/*]
[*]Inline tooltips with info such as machine, loved gifts, etc.[/*]
[*]UI Scale for Mobile and other goodies[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: - Changed Seed Maker tooltips to show price of a single seed
